status: Exploratory dated amendment; does not change the running audit or its original claim rule
supersedes_for_future_analysis: The trimap-width component of the original cross-definition claim rule only
reason: One memory token spans 10 pixels at author640. Narrow trimaps followed by nearest-neighbor token sampling can leave dotted boundary labels. Wider kernels test a broader token-scale band. GenMask samples randint(1,30), so 29 is within the author's supported range. Effective band width depends on contour geometry and interpolation; kernel/10 is not an exact band-width formula.

supplied_example_not_independently_repro.source: User-supplied test-polyp illustration; original mask and measurement procedure not supplied
supplied_example_not_independently_repro.interpretation: Illustrative cell coverage, not the audit's one-pixel contour coverage metric and not a universal guarantee that mixed cells cover every contour pixel

amended_claim_rule: For the amended analysis, seek consistent effect direction across primary mixed cells, author incoherence, trimaps 15/21/29 and inner band. Report k3/k7 transparently as sub-token sampling diagnostics but do not use them to veto this amended robustness claim. Preserve and separately report the original prespecified analysis; do not retroactively reclassify it as successful. No inference of causal utility from attention allocation alone.
offline_recomputation: Use unchanged author GenMask through an isolated copy of the existing adapter configured with 15/21/29. Saved native logits suffice for labels, contour coverage, GT agreement, counts and size strata; no new model inference.
attention: Current audit records regional totals for primary mixed cells only, not per-token mass. Saved logits cannot recover attention for amended trimaps. A separately gated read-only attention rerun is required; broader token logging is optional future work, not implemented by this amendment.
future_exclusions: Commit the exact contiguity-matched exclusion protocol, implementation, control specification and validated source identities before launching exclusions. This amendment does not authorize or launch those experiments.
